images.alt:
What is Tokenization in AI, and why does it matter?

Tokenization is one of the fundamental steps that helps AI models understand and process human language.

It breaks text into smaller units called tokens. These tokens can be complete words, parts of words, or punctuation marks.

For example, an AI model doesn't always process an entire sentence as one piece. It breaks the sentence into smaller tokens before processing it.

Why is tokenization important?

Helps AI process text efficiently.

Supports language understanding.

Makes text processing easier for AI models.

Plays an important role in Large Language Models (LLMs).

From chatbots to advanced AI assistants, tokenization is an essential part of how modern language AI works.
